task_zh: 使用 ggplot2 绘制散点图
detail: Maps the stated axes and layer; line sorts by x in ggplot while Stata uses sort here. Plot themes, axis expansion, missing-point warnings and facet scales follow R defaults.
detail_zh: 对应所示坐标轴及图层；ggplot的折线按x排序，此处Stata使用sort。主题、坐标轴留白、缺失点警告和分面尺度采用R默认设置。
setup: set.seed(281); data <- data.frame(x = seq_len(30), y = seq_len(30) / 2 + rnorm(30), group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 10)), z = rep(1:10, 3)); data$lo <- data$y - 1; data$hi <- data$y + 1; data$se <- rep(1, 30); data$label <- paste0("case", seq_len(30)); fit <- lm(y ~ x + z, data = data)

detail: The R example implements the graphical intent; size, jitter and theme scales are not numerically identical to Stata.
detail_zh: 该 R 示例实现相同的作图目的，但尺寸、随机扰动和主题参数的数值尺度不与 Stata 完全一致。

detail: This uses horizontally jittered observations rather than Stata dot-stacking rules.
detail_zh: 此处使用水平方向的随机扰动，不采用 Stata 的点堆叠规则。
setup: set.seed(281); data <- data.frame(x = seq_len(30), y = seq_len(30) / 2 + rnorm(30), group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 10)), z = rep(1:10, 3)); data$lo <- data$y - 1; data$hi <- data$y + 1; data$se <- rep(1, 30); data$label <- paste0("case", seq_len(30)); fit <- lm(y ~ x + z, data = data)

task: Plot spikes for the frequencies of distinct values
task_zh: 使用针状线表示各个取值的频数
detail: Draws one spike for each observed value with its count. Axis ticks, spike widths, handling of missing values and graphics device styling differ from Stata spikeplot.
detail_zh: 为每个观测取值按频数绘制竖线。坐标刻度、线宽、缺失处理和图形设备样式不同于Stata的spikeplot。
setup: set.seed(281); data <- data.frame(x = seq_len(30), y = seq_len(30) / 2 + rnorm(30), group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 10)), z = rep(1:10, 3)); data$lo <- data$y - 1; data$hi <- data$y + 1; data$se <- rep(1, 30); data$label <- paste0("case", seq_len(30)); fit <- lm(y ~ x + z, data = data)

r: ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x, y)) + ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = y - se, ymax = y + se)) + ggplot2::geom_point()
task: Plot supplied estimates and standard errors
task_zh: 绘制已有估计值及标准误
detail: Here se is a supplied standard-error variable; Stata serrbar defaults to one standard error. Rename the variable to suit your data.
detail_zh: 此处 se 为已有的标准误变量，Stata serrbar 默认显示一个标准误的范围；请按实际数据修改变量名。
setup: set.seed(281); data <- data.frame(x = seq_len(30), y = seq_len(30) / 2 + rnorm(30), group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 10)), z = rep(1:10, 3)); data$lo <- data$y - 1; data$hi <- data$y + 1; data$se <- rep(1, 30); data$label <- paste0("case", seq_len(30)); fit <- lm(y ~ x + z, data = data)

r: ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) + ggplot2::stat_summary_2d(fun = mean)
task: Heat map of the mean of z over binned x and y
task_zh: 按 x、y 分箱绘制 z 均值的热图
detail: Community command. Both average z within cells, but bin counts and boundaries differ; set bins explicitly (bins() in Stata, bins = in R) when comparing. Colour ramps follow each program's defaults.
detail_zh: 社区命令。两者都在单元格内计算 z 的均值，但分箱数量及边界不同；比较时请明确设定分箱（Stata 的 bins()，R 的 bins =）。配色采用各自默认设置。
setup: set.seed(598); data <- data.frame(x = runif(200), y = runif(200)); data$z <- data$x + data$y
meaning: heatplot: Heat map of the mean of z over binned x and y

r: ggplot2::ggplot(stats::aggregate(z ~ x + y, data = data, FUN = mean), ggplot2::aes(factor(x), factor(y), fill = z)) + ggplot2::geom_tile()
task: Heat map of the mean of z over categories of x and y
task_zh: 按 x、y 类别绘制 z 均值的热图
detail: Community command. One tile per observed x-y combination, filled with the mean of z; empty combinations are left blank in both.
detail_zh: 社区命令。每个出现过的 x、y 组合对应一个方块，填充 z 的均值；两者都不绘制空组合。
setup: data <- data.frame(x = rep(1:3, each = 4), y = rep(1:2, 6), z = 1:12)
meaning: heatplot: Heat map of the mean of z over categories of x and y
